title: Invoice parser whose tests run with one command
task: Write `invoices.Parse(r io.Reader) ([]Invoice, error)` for our line format `ID|customer|cents|YYYY-MM-DD`, one invoice per line, blank lines ignored, any other malformed line an error naming the line number. Running `go test -cover ./...` must be the only step: no script, no environment variable, no generated fixture files, no network.
